title: Expose total_parts in YencMetadata; verify =ybegin total= field parsing
description: The =ybegin header for multi-part articles includes a 'total=' field (e.g. 'total=5'). The current YencMetadata struct does not expose this. Add 'total_parts: Option<u32>' to YencMetadata (None for single-part articles where the field is absent). The Python fixture generator in tests/fixtures/gen_fixtures.py already emits 'total=2' in multi_part_1.yenc and multi_part_2.yenc -- verify the parser reads it and the field round-trips correctly. This is needed by yencoding-multi to avoid requiring callers to track the total separately from subject-line parsing.
close_reason: total_parts: Option<u32> added to YencMetadata. Parsed from =ybegin total= field. Tested in decode_multi_part_{1,2}_fixture.
